bead.bead_why: both jambs step monotonically leaf -> reveal -> frame face with no overshoot; the right frame face is bright (1.30) but it is a 21 px plane, not a line

cast.cast_why: render wall runs at 165-197 straight into the frame face on both sides with no darkening in the last pixels; the porch is open and the light diffuse

threshold.threshold_why: no threshold section - the leaf meets a poured concrete apron with only a 3 px dark line between

window.shape: very tall narrow rectangle, moulded surround, 0.78 of leaf height

peephole.peephole_why: the round chrome boss at 0.94/0.54 is a keyed cylinder escutcheon (keyway clearly visible at 9x), not a lens; no other boss on the leaf

hinges.hinges_why: bar and lock are on the right of the leaf so hinges are on the left, inside a 31 px reveal; no knuckles break the edge at 6x

extras: fixed narrow second leaf to the right with a matching glazed slot
dense wrought-iron scrollwork filling both glazed slots
brushed-steel vertical pull bar, 0.52 of leaf height
moulded architrave around the glazed slot
recessed porch: 61 px of soffit and 21 px frame faces on both jambs
notes: Main leaf measured; the narrow fixed leaf to its right is excluded, so far_w is the opening's right jamb (which borders that fixed leaf).
